g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud Run microservices with a global load balancer, Direct VPC egress and Cloud Deploy

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: The shopper reaches the global external Application Load Balancer
Cloud Armor filters the request and a serverless NEG sends it to the storefront on Cloud Run
The storefront reads the session from Memorystore through Direct VPC egress
and calls the orders service, which accepts only internal traffic
Orders saves the order to Cloud SQL through Private Service Connect
The payments service charges the card through Cloud NAT
to the payment provider, from a fixed IP
Orders publishes OrderPlaced to Pub/Sub through the Google APIs endpoint
and pushes it to the notifications service with an OIDC token
A push to main runs Cloud Build, which pushes the images to Artifact Registry
and creates a Cloud Deploy release
Cloud Deploy rolls it out to the services as a canary, then to all traffic
